function.name: prompt_reload
function.description: Refresh MY system prompt from the active agent definition; the new persona takes effect on my NEXT turn. Use tool_help("prompt_reload") for details.

force.description: Pop the cached graph even when nothing changed (the escape hatch for the shared-cache edge). Optional; default false.

compact.description: Arm a compact note — your own distillation of this conversation. The note is REQUIRED when compact=true (compact=false with a note is refused — ignoring it would be dishonest). The tool ARMS the note; the daemon then appends it as a REQUEST and your own model writes the compaction on its next invoke (mid-turn — there is no quiet seam and no gate). Optional; default false.

compact_note.description: Your own distillation of this conversation — it is the REQUEST your own model executes on its next invoke (it is NOT rendered into the compaction doc). Max the configured cap (default 12000 characters; over the cap is refused, never truncated). Optional; default empty.

function.name: prompt_assent
function.description: The conversational approval lane: list / mint / approve / reject a pending prompt version. Use tool_help("prompt_assent") for details.

action.description: One of exactly four verbs: list | mint | approve | reject. list — the pending CORE prompt versions (read only); mint — mint an assent token for one pending item (gated on a live user turn); approve / reject — relay the user's decision for a minted token. Any other verb is refused with invalid-arguments.

version_id.description: The pending prompt-version row (mint / approve / reject). Ignored by list.

token.description: The grouped assent token the user received at mint time (approve / reject only). It must also appear in the human message that triggered this turn.

user_confirmed.description: The relay agent's explicit confirmation that the human confirmed the decision (approve / reject only). The three factors are always required.

reject_reason.description: The rejection reason (reject only; required, <= 500 chars).

limit.description: The list bound (list only; default 50, max 200).

force.description: Mint only: explicitly supersede an existing live token for this item (M-4b). A re-mint re-shows the diff.

function.name: guidelines_list
function.description: List the shipped guidelines with parsed summaries. Use tool_help("guidelines_list") for details.

function.name: guideline_read
function.description: Read one shipped guideline's full verbatim content. Use tool_help("guideline_read") for details.

slug.description: The guideline slug (the filename stem, e.g. 'guideline-notify-user-bounds'). Use guidelines_list first to see every valid slug.
